Name: OLPHES
Description:
Pumped Hydro Energy Storage (PHES) accounts for 95% of global energy storage capacity and is 10 times cheaper than batteries, with lowest levelised cost of electricity due to 100 year operationality compared with 10 years for batteries.

PHES needs an upper and a lower reservoir conected through a penstock and water is recirculated between them, by pumping water from the lower reservoir into the upper one, when low demand and electricity prices in the grid, and let the water falls back through the reversible turbine pump, on pick demand and prices. 
Energy storage paired with renewable generation will boost the penetration of renewables globaly according to "Finkel report"

One Lake Pumped Hydro Energy Storage OLPHES, is a  renewable energy technology owned by Canberra based Energy Storage Rights that holds the regional IP rights for Australia, Indonesia, Philippines, New Zealand, Romania and 10 other pacific countries, granted by Innsbruck University, Austria.

The technology has the following characteristics:
·  single reservoir – removing the need for a 2nd reservoir and associated infrastructure, thereby reducing CAPEX by > 50% compared with the standard 2 reservoir project
·   can be installed in gulfs, mine pit lakes, as well as reservoirs, and off-shore; the deeper the water body, the higher its storage capacity
·   modular & scalable – enabling standardised components to be manufactured off-site, agglomerated to a desired scale and deployed in paralel with a floating or standard solar farm.

OLPHES can store 1 MWh into a concrete cylinder with 20 m radius and 20 m height, that floats on a lake, like in the above animation, has a reversible pump-turbine at the bottom, that is powered by solar or wind energy.
Increasing the hight of the cylinder to 100 m, the storage capacity increases to 5 MWh, generating 1MW for 5 hours.
OLPH its easily to scale up further 10 times, by floating 9 similar cylinders, that are positioned circular and share the reversible pump-turbine with the central one by connecting pipes.

OLPHES light can be build from inflatable rubber cylinders.

Name: EOLOGIX-PING
Description:
EOLOGIX-PING is the specialist for continuous blade monitoring with innovative ON-BLADE, ON-TOWER and IN-BLADE sensor systems for ice detection, temperature measurement, blade damage detection and lightning monitoring.

Our goal is to support the generation of wind energy by developing innovative sensor solutions and enabling permanent and accurate monitoring of rotor blade condition and operation to achieve the best performance for our customers.

Our motivated team is committed to ensuring the best possible performance and capability of wind turbines worldwide. 

The patented and DNV certified ON-BLADE solution is mounted directly on the blade surface. With its innovative technology, the sensor system is able to reliably detect icing, measure surface temperature for preventive heating. Furthermore, it detects even the smallest rotor blade misalignment under all turbine operating conditions.

The ON-TOWER system continuously measures and analyzes changes in the sound generated by blade damage. It is attached magnetically to the base of the tower of the wind turbine at a height of approximately four meters. Through an add-on, it can detect not only blade damage but also lightning strikes through magnetic field measurements and provide data for setting appropriate measures.

The acoustic IN-BLADE system is installed at the blade access panel or within the blade depending on the preference. There it uses sound emission to detect root zone structural damage.

All sensor solutions are suitable for new installations as well as for simple retrofitting on existing wind turbines.

•	Respectful: We acknowledge that we all come from different places, yet we seek common ground where we find it. We respect local cultural protocols and are mindful that our industry is grounded in thousands of years of traditional knowledge and practice. 
•	Transparent and Accountable; We are a trusted independent voice for the Indigenous carbon industry.

What we do
Our objectives are defined in the ICIN Ltd Constitution agreed by all members.

Name: Plastron Solutions Pty Ltd
Description:
Plastron Solutions has developed an efficient system that turns plastic waste into fuel. Efficient at low temperatures, requiring a small installation investment in comparison to competitors, and with a low environmental impact, our technology is positioned to help waste processors eliminate plastic waste.

Our system takes raw plastic waste, shreds it, sorts it and pyrolysis it, then further process it into fuel, which can be used for vehicles, heat or to generate electricity. The toxic chemical additives within most plastics are utilised along with the non-recoverable gasses to produce energy that helps run the plant – making it self-powering and reducing its environmental footprint. Each Plastron module can convert up to 8 tonnes of plastic waste a day into up to 3,500 litres of pyrolysis oil and up to 3 tonnes of recyclable plastic flakes, producing approximately 1 million litres of fuel each year, and removing more than 2,400 tonnes of plastic from the planet. 

Our system can complement the large-scale, expensive waste-to-energy plants that handle a wide variety of waste forms. With each module requiring only 100 m2 of space, excluding holding tanks for the fuel produced, the Plastron solution is relatively compact.

Name: Econnect Solar
Description:
Since launching in 2018, Econnect Solar have helped thousands of Australian home owners save over $16million in electricity bills. 

As one of Australia’s fastest growing solar companies, we have opened five local offices ranging from Canberra to Townsville, without compromising on service or installation quality. This is due to the guaranteed after care service provided by in-house, Clean Energy Council accredited electricians. 

Our Story
When the solar boom began, our founders were subcontracting as licensed electricians. Responsible for installing over 50,000 solar panels and adding over 13 million Watts of power to the grid, they started to see a dark side to the industry. 

Big sales companies were charging over the top prices for solar systems they had little knowledge of, and most of these companies provided no aftercare. However, what the industry was rife with, was 'Bobs'. Self-employed electricians that were installing systems and charging low prices to capitalise on the demand. These ‘Bobs’ thought solar was an easy business to get into, until they realised the cost of guaranteed aftercare. 

That’s why Econnect Solar was born.

No upfront cost
Instead of charging over the top prices, we developed the Econnect pricing formula. By calculating the overall cost, solar rebate, finance repayments, bill size and kWh usage, we design unique payment plans where your solar savings cover the cost of your system.

Advice you can trust
With so many ‘Bobs’ in the solar industry, we are focused on being upfront. Honesty is an integral part of our culture and our values, and we aim to be as transparent as possible in everything we do. 

Local, in-house teams
All staff undergo extensive training, to keep everything in-house. This helps our Clean Energy Council accredited electricians and Econnect Aftercare teams provide you with the best end-to-end experience.

The Solex Project not only avoids GHG emissions and reduces fossil fuel consumption but it also serves as a case study model from reducing existing GHG emissions through the Chattamarra Project trial to repair rangelands degradation. 

The Solex Project also serves as a research/demonstration facility to demonstrate to researchers and the broader population how fossil fuel dependency can be substituted not only for economic benefit but also  to provide benefits to society and the natural environment.

The device is simple: a transparent two-liter bottle is filled with water plus a little bleach to inhibit algal growth and fitted into a hole in a roof. The device functions like a deck prism: during daytime the water inside the bottle refracts sunlight, delivering about as much light as a 40–60 watt incandescent bulb to the interior. A properly installed solar bottle can last up to 5 years

Through a network of partnerships around the world, Liter of Light volunteers teach marginalised communities how to use recycled plastic bottles and locally sourced materials to illuminate their homes, businesses, and streets.

Liter of Light has installed more than 350,000 bottle lights in more than 15 countries and taught green skills to empower grassroots entrepreneurs at every stop.

Liter of Light's open source technology has been recognized by the UN and adopted for use in some UNHCR camps. Liter of Light is the proud recipient of the 2016 St. Andrews Prize for the Environment, the 2015 Zayed Future Energy Prize, and a winner of the 2014-2015 World Habitat Award.

The Wheat Straw arose from the collaboration of two friends, trying to find an alternative to the single use plastic straw. We had the most simple idea: a straw made with... straw. 

How are they made? The straws are made from natural wheat stems. Once the wheat is ready to be harvested, the farmer keeps the cereal and we keep the stems. They are then processed to ensure that there is no dirt or insects. They are rinsed, boiled and then dried. Due to the fact that it is a natural product, the thickness and colour of the straws may vary a little from one plant to another. No worries! 
The straws are Gluten Free: by definition gluten is the protein that is in the cereal grains. There are traces of gluten in the straws but are still deemed gluten free by scientist. 
They are tasteless. 
They are biodegradable and compostable. 
They are environmentally friendly. 
... They are The Wheat Straw !

Name: PVSTOP
Description:
► The Problem
When exposed to light, solar panels cannot be turned off. This presents a risk during maintenance or emergency situations. PV Stop solves this problem; it is the only reactive solution that switches off solar panels, ensuring that both rescue personnel and the public are safe in any instances where solar panels need to be made safe. 

► The Solution
PV Stop is a non-flammable fire retardant, polymer film technology. It acts as a “liquid blanket” that non-destructively shuts down photovoltaic panels in seconds. 

As the only reactive fire retardant solution on the global market capable of deactivating photovoltaic panels in all weather conditions, PV Stop eliminates the risk of high voltage DC electrocution. Once applied you can peel PV Stop off solar panels up to 12 months after application without damaging the photovoltaic panels.

With the exponential growth of solar installations in Australia and across the globe.  PV Stop is the only solution to solar panel safety.

► The Team
With a team that has extensive experience in the design and installation of photovoltaic energy systems, we are committed to making solar power a more viable and safe option across the world.

With over 1 billion solar panels installed globally, we’re committed to real solutions to real problems.

Name: Sunovate
Description:
Sunovate is a clean tech development Company that was established specifically to commercialize novel renewable energy technologies. The newest of our clean-tech projects, Sunovate is the culmination of our work in the solar industry.

The world is in the middle of an accelerating energy transition from fossil to sustainable energy sources and the demand for sustainable energy is booming. Heating accounts for more than 65% of final energy consumption in the energy sector. Only a fraction of that heat is being produced through solar technology.

Sunovate is an innovative new technology that produces both electricity and heat. This is called photo-voltaic thermal (PVT). 

According to the International Energy Agency the PV/T technology is the most promising way to capture the energy of the sun. PV/T is heat and electricity on the same square meters; delivering up to 4 times more energy as conventional PV. With roof space at a premium combining heat & electricity on the same square meters makes sense. 

The Sunovate system deploys the benefits of both PV and solar heating in the one package. It allows our customers to make big savings on energy costs whilst reducing their environmental impact. The Sunovate design reduces system complexities and costs associated with other PVT designs whilst also providing consumers greater flexibility in the way they use energy.

SUNOVATE PVT USES:
Pool Heating  +  Space Heating  +  Water Heating + Night Time Space Cooling  +  Harvesting Water Condensate  +  District Heating  +  Low Grade Steam  +  Process Drying  +  Emergency Relief

With energy costs rising & demand spiraling – smarter energy options are required. That’s why we have developed Sunovate. Our mission is to reduce the cost of energy & drastically reduce CO2 emissions.

Name: Solpod
Description:
Solpod was founded in 2017 by a team of experienced solar executives,
members of whom previously founded one of Australia’s largest rooftop solar businesses and have developed over $200 million of utility solar projects. The team recognised a gap in the market where standard solar was not meeting the needs of the commercial and industrial property sector. While the economics of solar can be strong, this may involve taking a 15+year view on the asset, which is appropriate for solar technology but not necessarily the site or owner, who may want to redevelop the site or change the roof sheet in that time. Standard solar cannot be economically removed during the asset life, as the cost of labor to remove it is higher than the value of the used kit. 

Solpod is developed, headquartered and manufactured in Melbourne, Australia. The technology benefited from the support of the Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA) to fast track commercialisation of the technology, and has contracted multiple systems with GPT (one of Australia’s largest property owners), Property NSW (a government statutory body) and Mirvac (a leading Australian property group)

Solpod’s technology:

- reduces construction time and therefore disruption at site as the system is installed as 12 panel pods

- does not require penetrations in the roof sheet for fixing

- improves system QA/QC outcomes, as more work is performed in a factory rather than on a roof

-is Australia’s only rooftop solar mounting manufacturer.

-provides future flexibility, as Solpods can be relocated if required due to future requirements

Solpod prefabricates ‘pods’ of 10 panels (4.6kW per pod), which are then trucked to site and craned into position, connecting to pre-installed feet. Solpods are fabricated in a quality controlled factory environment and all pods are tested and tagged before leaving the factory.

Description:
Lava Blue is a science-led unlisted public company developing a High Purity Alumina project on granted mining and exploration permits, and planned processing factory, in north Queensland.

The global economy is rapidly moving to replace fossil fuels with renewable energy generation and electrical transport systems, creating an entirely new mineral sector –   Critical Minerals – a sector in which Australia is becoming a market leader. For instance, in 2018 Australian companies produced more than 60% of the lithium metal in the world, a commodity that a decade prior was almost a waste product from tantalum production. 

As part of the unstoppable global trend to the use of metals in energy production and storage High Purity Alumina – used as the basis for LEDs and as a critical material in Lithium ion batteries - has begun to experience surging demand, and once again Australia is in a prime position to become the global leader in supply, with Queensland identified as a key focus.

High purity alumina (>99.99% Al2O3) (HPA) is a chemically inert ceramic material with high thermal and electrical resistivity, properties that has made it the basis for all LEDs and sapphire glass, and highly effective in electronic displays and in semiconductors. In addition, HPA Is now a critical material for separators for both lithium and aluminium batteries, which significantly increase the safety and the energy density of the batteries.

Through our Intelligent PL Solutions platform, we deliver truly inline and offline inspection systems supporting silicon, thin‐film, perovskite, and tandem technologies. A common inspection intelligence layer across wafers, cells, and modules enables faster learning cycles, lower risk, and confident scale‐up of next‐generation cell architectures.

BT Imaging’s leadership is grounded in ethically developed, predominantly self‐originated — and selectively partnership‐based — intellectual property spanning luminescence physics, system architectures, and inspection analytics. This provides customers with confidence and investors with a durable technology moat.

With 350+ systems deployed globally, BT Imaging is the longest‐running revenue‐generating solar (equipment) manufacturer in Australia and a trusted partner to Tier‐1 manufacturers worldwide.

Looking ahead, we are extending inspection intelligence beyond the factory floor with onsite inspection solutions for warehouses and solar power plants, and AI‐driven technologies linking manufacturing insight with long‐term performance.

Description:
Each of us, in addition to being a consumer, can become a producer and manager of its own energy, reducing its dependence on the centralized electricity grid. In summary: become an evolved prosumer.
Energy autonomy is now becoming a reality, a necessity, an objective. So what does it take to get rid of an energy production that still depends largely on fossil fuels?
The answer is the intelligent sharing of solar energy produced, stored and managed efficiently within a virtuous system with exponential growth: the smart grid.
Our big picture is to use Regalgrid ‘patented’ hardware/software technology  architecture to allow our customers to make the most out of their photovoltaic systems, storing and managing the excess of energy or sharing it with other members of the community.
The architecture consists of three levels:
1. SNOCU (Smart NOde Control Unit),
an innovative gateway that connects to the Regalgrid platform, turning energy
flows into digital data and sending the commands that each inverter and battery must implement for a more efficient customer/community management.
2. Server platform in the cloud,
the hub of Regalgrid is the virtual place where data are elaborated through the use of sophisticated algorithms to define the strategies required to increase the users self-consumption.
3. Remote archive platform 
for storing data, remote diagnosis and energy analysis.
Our device and services are suitable for a wide range of users, such as:

• Households with individual houses;
• Developers of multiple real estate units
behind single POD (residence, hotels,
campsites, etc.);
• Industrial and commercial units;
• Public administrations;
• Regalgrid technology is applicable either to on-grid (connected to a national
public network) or off-grid contexts.

Description:
Cocuyo energy designs and manufactures electricity generators, to extract energy from the ocean waves.

The patented technology is novel and innovative, and it solves the many issues previously encountered with electricity generators that are submerged in the sea.

Commercially feasible extraction of energy from the ocean has proven elusive in the past, with many attempts ending with prototypes that would require much maintenance and would have short lives.  The Cocuyo generator has solved all these existing issues, and the generators can remain in the sea for 10-20 years, without the need to change parts, and without requiring removal and replacement for refurbishing.  

The Cocuyo generators will open the path for a new reliable source of renewable energy extraction – one that is available 24hrs a day 365 day a year.  Day or night, sun or not, wind or not, storm or calm, the Cocuyo generators continuously extract energy from the ocean waves.  Protected against the effect of storms and king tides, during a storm, where other sources of electricity struggle, the Cocuyo generators continue to produce energy non-stop.

Our mission is to facilitate the energy extraction from the ocean, to allow humanity to use this inexhaustible green energy to power the world and its progress.

We envisage a stage in history where clean affordable energy can be used to power up the towns and cities of the world, with a sizeable portion being extracted from the ocean.

OriSolar Pty LTD is an Australian company with very unique solution to improve commercials, utilities and residential solar system performance to accelerate your investment, by preventing and restoring PV panels cells from PID problems. 

Solar power in Australia is a fast growing industry. As of March 2019, Australia's over 2 million solar PV installations had a combined capacity of 12,035 MW photovoltaic (PV) solar power, of which 4,068 MW were installed in the preceding 12 months. In 2019, 59 solar PV projects with a combined capacity of 2,881 MW were either under construction, constructed or due to start construction having reached financial closure. Solar accounted for 5.2% (or 11.7 TWh) of Australia's total electrical energy production (227.8 TWh) in 2018. 
As well Hundreds and thousands of people have installed solar panels on their roofs just in the past decade. Despite the utility of these panels, they begin to lose their efficiency with time, Unfortunately, most people only realize this when the damage is done. 
The culprit behind? PID or Potential Induced Degradation. Potential Induced Degradation (PID) is an performance accelerated degradation phenomenon in photovoltaic modules , caused by so-called ‘stray current’. This effect may cause power loss of up to 80 percent. 

Potential Induced Degradation, as the definition implies, occurs when the PV modules voltage potential and leakage current drive ion mobility within the PV module between the semiconductor material and other elements of the module (e.g. glass, mount and frame) thus causing the module’s power output capacity to degrade. The ion mobility accelerates with humidity, high temperature and voltage potential. PID affects all solar panels, the PN junction of the cell is destroyed, making the cells less productive, less efficient. 

Thanks to OriSolar Anti PID, we have a solution to restore the cells productivity and increase the efficiency of PV cells within 40 days .

Description:
Your Energy Friend was founded in 2006 with a vision of providing truly independent Home Energy Assessments for householders. To date we have conducted over 6000 Home Energy Assessments.

•	Building Envelope and associated energy savings through insulation and sealing the house
•	Ceiling Insulation Inspection and recommendations
•	Hot Water savings and viability of Solar Hot Water or Heat Pumps
•	Lighting efficiency opportunities and savings
•	Heating, Air Conditioning usage and possible improvement to performance and usage
•	Standby Power savings
•	All Appliances and usage and savings opportunities
•	Entertainment & Computer Equipment usage and savings opportunities
•	Solar PV Viability
•	All other energy savings opportunities
•	We also ensure that the resident is receiving best electricity and gas rates 
•	Electricity, gas and Water bills are bills are explained in detail to the resident to ensure that they are empowered to monitor and manage them into the future.

Once a household assessment is completed a detailed action plan is developed detailing all opportunities available to the resident. 

Our assessments, or audits as they are sometimes called have been conducted in partnership with Local Councils, Electricity Network Companies (e.g. Ausgrid and Integral Energy), Electricity Retail Companies, State and Federal Governments initiatives and NGO’s.
